transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling incredibly depressed and just constantly sad for the last seven months. It feels like a heavy cloud that won't go away, and I just can't shake this darkness.
Have you had periods of feeling this way for most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years, or is this a more recent ongoing episode?
This is a more recent, ongoing episode rather than something that has lasted for two years. I have been feeling this way constantly for about seven months now.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities, even things you used to enjoy?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in everything I used to enjoy, like reading and gardening. Even when I try to do them, I don't feel any happiness or satisfaction at all. It's like all the pleasure has been completely drained out of my life.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or my weight recently. It seems to have stayed pretty much the same.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, such as difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much?

My sleep has been completely ruined lately. It takes me forever to fall asleep, I wake up constantly during the night, and then I find myself wide awake too early in the morning. Even when I sleep for a long time, I have awful nightmares and wake up feeling just as exhausted as before.
Have you been feeling excessively guilty, worthless, or like a burden to others?

Yes, I feel completely worthless and like a constant burden to everyone in my life. I am always replaying my past mistakes in my head and feeling terrible guilt over trivial daily things, like I deserve to be punished. It just feels like everything is my fault.
Have you noticed any changes in your movement or speech, such as feeling slowed down or restless and unable to sit still?

Yes, I've experienced both. Often, I feel completely slowed down, like my body is moving through mud and it takes me a long time just to speak or respond. But other times, I get this awful inner restlessness where I can't sit still and just have to pace or fidget constantly.
